message: `alloc` is no longer part of Axiom
label: `alloc` was refused rather than implemented: the form typed as a pointer and evaluated to the constant 0, so a program holding one held no memory
help: allocate with `__alloc`, or use `vecNew`, `strAlloc` or a struct: `(alloc T n)` typed `*mut T` and evaluated to 0, so it never allocated anything
